title: [CQ-I06f] Client epic gate and review ahead of R13 certification
description:
Re-slice of CQ-I06 (task-4e412148), on architect-66fd8127's proposal (comment-5d31f120 on I06, #architects msg-7126fcf1), per the governor's 16:24Z scope ruling.

**Why it can run now.** The CQ-I epic gate and the whole-epic adversarial review need only landed code: guest-supervisor.py sha256 3a19f3bf… and I01-I06c/I06e. They do not need R13's certification reports. Only DoD 3's certified-host half needs those, and it stays with I06.

**Scope.** CQ-I06 rev-2 plan steps 3A-B and 4, carried over:
- 3A, VERIFY ONCE, full regression. Run it in an isolated snapshot, never in the shared tree, with MOE_* cleared.
- 3B, Windows engines:
  - both IDEs launch seats with Windows PowerShell 5.1;
  - the PS 5.1 and pwsh 7 wrapper suites, under Windows Node;
  - the gradle gate `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` (on this host, the labelled Windows equivalent);
  - the packaged-plugin checks.
- `node scripts/local-runner/cli.mjs prerequisites` runs under both Linux and Windows Node.
- Step 4: the ADVERSARIAL WHOLE-EPIC REVIEW over the CQ-I commits (I01, I02, I03a, I03, I04, I05, I06a, I06b, I06c, I06e). Load adversarial-self-review.

**Host certification.** Record per-platform native certification as "pending CQ-R13" and defer to docs/CERTIFICATION.md; never infer a result.

**Files.** Fixes go forward only in the owning module, small, and are named in modifiedFiles. No wrapper (scripts/moe-agent.*) and no scripts/local-runner/ file: any finding there becomes a filed row, not an edit here.

**Afterwards.** CQ-I06 keeps R13 and V12. Its replanned remainder records DoD 3's certified-host half once R13 is DONE.
definitionOfDone: Both clients consume identical daemon verdicts: the shared corpus moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-verdicts.json passes under JetBrains JUnit and VS Code node:test, fresh.
The packaged plugins contain every required production helper asset and no test fixtures: the onboarding packaged checks pass on the built JetBrains zip and on real VS Code bundler output.

Windows engines are recorded honestly: PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7 wrapper suites under Windows Node, with each engine labelled. Native host certification is recorded as 'pending CQ-R13', and no per-platform result is claimed.
A fresh `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` (or the labelled Windows equivalent on this host) exits 0, and its output is supplied to complete_task.
The whole-epic adversarial review is done and its findings listed. Each finding is fixed in its owning module or filed as a row; none is silently dropped.

implementationPlan.description:
PREFLIGHT AND LINUX SNAPSHOT REGRESSION (I06 rev-2 run 3A; the VS Code halves of DoD 1 and DoD 2). This step edits no tracked file.

Preflight:
- CQ-I06e must have landed: `git log moe/work-2026-10-24 --format=%h --grep 'Moe-Task: task-66d3b2588bfb45c6934710aee02a79f0'` is non-empty.
- Record SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD). Each CQ-I commit must be an ancestor (`git merge-base --is-ancestor <c> $SHA`): I01 263e9f53, I02 43ce5cb3, I03a ad8097f7, I03 d53c62eb, I04 82aa4ee9, I05 14ee8f86, I06a 9eef7767, I06d 12fd4333, I06c 5143b4c7, I06b 1422c1d9 and 45a4ac0b, bug 5e816f2c 777a414b, and I06e's completion. Every later step uses this one SHA.
- Snapshot:
  - SNAP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/moe-i06f.XXXXXX); chmod 700 it; record the path.
  - `git archive $SHA | tar -x -C $SNAP/repo`, archiving the WHOLE repo: the tests read docs/, ci.yml, gradle and ../moe-jetbrains.
- Every Linux run uses `env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin NO_COLOR=1` with umask 022. That clears MOE_* and keeps the Windows PATH out (mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate).
- Run `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` in the snapshot's packages/moe-daemon, packages/moe-proxy, packages/moe-claude-plugin and moe-vscode. Never run npm in /mnt/d/projexts/moes.
- A subagent such as moe-test-runner may run commands but never edits. Its brief must carry the snapshot-only rule and the no-pattern-kill rule.

Runs, in order, each fresh. Log to $SNAP/logs and cite ANSI-stripped `grep -a` tails, not dumps:
A1 `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test && npx tsc --noEmit`. This is full regression, because I01 changed /ws.
A2 `cd packages/moe-proxy && npm test`. Its pretest rebuilds dist.
A3 `cd packages/moe-claude-plugin && npm run build && npm test`. Its hook is a /ws client.
A4 `cd moe-vscode && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test`, as CI runs it. DoD 1: the output shows every corpus row passing, approval A01-A27 and vm V01-V23 (plan-review.test.cjs, managed-vm-verdicts.test.cjs). Record the sha256 of client-verdicts.json.
A5 Copy the `node --test` line of CI step 'Test local runner prerequisite bundles' (11 files) verbatim from the snapshot's ci.yml, and run it from the repo root.
A6 DoD 2, VS Code half:
  - `npm run build` in packages/moe-daemon and packages/moe-proxy, after A1, because prebuild regenerates sources;
  - then `node moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs`;
  - `node scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs moe-vscode/bundled` and `node scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs` each print their PASS line;
  - `find moe-vscode/bundled -path '*/node_modules' -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.test.*' -o -name '*.spec.*' -o -iname '*testharness*' \) -print` prints nothing.
A7 Repo-root `npm run lint`.
A8 `node scripts/local-runner/cli.mjs prerequisites`. Record the exit code and the providerCode/ready fields verbatim. Not ready is a fact to record, not a failure: there is no Multipass here.

TRIAGE is the error handling for any red result, in every step:
(1) Re-run the failing file alone once, and record both runs.
(2) If no CQ-I commit touched the failing test or the source it exercises, it is a peer or pre-existing failure. HEAD carries peers' wip checkpoints, e.g. 24a8b95c WT-08 and e53ec31b R13. Name its owning open row (moe.search_tasks) or file one (moe.create_task), and record it.
(3) If a CQ-I commit caused it, fix forward in the owning module, at most ~20 lines plus a test, using the Edit tool only (never a shell write or a subagent edit), and name the file in modifiedFiles. Never touch scripts/moe-agent.*, scripts/local-runner/ or .moe/; a finding there becomes a filed row. Anything bigger becomes a filed defect row, plus moe.report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds when it breaks DoD 1, 2 or 4.
Never weaken, skip or retag a test.

WINDOWS GRADLE GATE AND JETBRAINS ZIP (I06 rev-2 runs 7 and 10; DoD 4, plus the JetBrains halves of DoD 1 and DoD 2).

Windows copy of the SAME $SHA:

- Drive Windows from WSL bash as `cmd.exe /d /c '<cmd>'` with cwd under /mnt/d, and read each exit code immediately. Never chain the gate with other suites (mem:gotcha-gradle-uptodate-inside-chained-gate).
- Prove Windows node inherits no MOE_*: `"/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" -e "console.log(process.version, Object.keys(process.env).filter(k => /^MOE_/i.test(k)))"` prints v24.x and [].
- Before the lease, install fresh with Windows npm in the copy: `cmd.exe /d /c 'cd /d D:\projexts\i06f-win\packages\moe-daemon && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build'`, then the same for packages\moe-proxy. Check dist\index.js exists in both. Never link or junction node_modules from another tree, so deleting the copy stays safe.

Lease:
- moe.acquire_resource {resourceId:'jetbrains-gradle'} covers B1 and the buildPlugin run.
- moe.release_resource on every exit path, failures included.
- If the lease is queued: moe.report_blocked with resourceId 'jetbrains-gradle'.
- Never `gradlew --stop`, and never delete shared Gradle caches or %TEMP% entries.

B1 THE GATE (DoD 4):
- Run `cmd.exe /d /c 'set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\projexts\i06f-win\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun'`. It must exit 0, with `> Task :test` NOT UP-TO-DATE.
- From build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml, all written after the start time, record suites, tests, failures, errors and skipped.
- Name these classes as run with 0 failures: ClientVerdictCorpusTest (DoD 1: 3 tests, same corpus), PlanReviewApprovalStateTest, PlanApprovalContractTest, MoeMessageDispatcherErrorTest, ManagedVmPresentationTest.
- `command -v java` in WSL is empty, so label the run as the Windows equivalent of the pinned `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test`. Keep its console tail for complete_task.
- If it fails with 'Could not receive a message from the daemon', that is a client OOM: re-run once (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-client-oom).

B2 JETBRAINS ZIP (DoD 2):
- Run `cmd.exe /d /c 'set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\projexts\i06f-win\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat buildPlugin'`; buildSearchableOptions is off, so no IDE starts. Release the lease.
- Unzip build/distributions/*.zip into $WIN/plugin-smoke, as CI's 'Verify packaged JetBrains onboarding' does.
- `cmd.exe /d /c 'cd /d D:\projexts\i06f-win && node scripts\tests\onboarding.mjs D:\projexts\i06f-win\plugin-smoke\moe-jetbrains'` must print its PASS line. It uses a temp profile, strips MOE_* and stops its own daemon.
- The A6 find over $WIN/plugin-smoke prints nothing.
- `unzip -l` of each jar under plugin-smoke/moe-jetbrains/lib shows no client-verdicts.json and no *Test.class.

Error handling: if buildPlugin cannot run on this host (MAX_PATH, missing platform artifacts), record the exact error. Then cite a CI 'Verify packaged JetBrains onboarding' run of this exact $SHA (gh run list/view), if one exists. Otherwise moe.report_blocked with the error. Never claim a zip that was not built. Red tests: TRIAGE (step 1).

WINDOWS ENGINES AND HOST RECORD (I06 rev-2 runs 8, 9 and 3C; DoD 3). No lease.

Run everything from the step-2 copy, never the shared tree: its moe-agent.ps1/.sh and scripts/tests carry peers' dirty bytes. Use `cmd.exe /d /c 'cd /d D:\projexts\i06f-win && <cmd>'`, one command at a time, and record each exit code.

- Windows `node --version`;
- `powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()'` (5.1);
- the same with pwsh.exe (7.x, the WindowsApps alias; mem:gotcha-pwsh7-reachable-from-wsl).

W1 'Test launcher daemon.json cap and seat re-registration': `node --test scripts\tests\daemon-json-cap.test.mjs scripts\tests\seat-registration.test.mjs` (Git Bash, 5.1 and 7 legs).
W2 PowerShell 5.1:

  - then `node scripts\tests\postflight-safe.mjs powershell`. Its JSON line must say exit 0 and failureClass NONE. It takes about 20-30 min; background it, record the PID and kill only that PID.

W4 A5's local-runner line under Windows node. Record pass and skip counts; the guest legs skip off Linux.
W5 `node scripts\local-runner\cli.mjs prerequisites`. Record the exit and providerCode next to A8's.
W6 Packaged wrapper:

HOST CERTIFICATION: record it as 'pending CQ-R13', deferring to docs/CERTIFICATION.md '## Certified platforms'. Never run native-smoke or certify: they launch a real VM, and there is no Multipass here. Never infer a per-platform result, even from that table's current rows.
